method: Inherited tracker claims, including file-presence and TODO heuristics. Not current verified parity.

entities:blaze.note: Shoots fireballs but has normal gravity and ground navigation, so it cannot hover.

entities:bogged.note: Wraps the skeleton base, so it shoots a bow like vanilla.

items.text: Skeleton goal set with bow attack

entities:breeze.note: Wanders and targets players but never attacks; the wind charge projectile exists, nothing fires it.

entities:cave_spider.note: Difficulty-scaled poison, daylight-gated targeting, and armadillo avoidance are implemented. LeapAtTargetGoal and wall-climbing navigation remain missing.

items.text: Difficulty-scaled poison on melee hit and `SpiderTargetGoal`
Freezes while a player looks at it

entities:creeper.note: Ignites and explodes like vanilla. Only the effect cloud is missing.

items.text: Area effect cloud from potion effects

entities:drowned.note: Implements ranged trident attacks, amphibious water/ground navigation switching, beach/water seeking goals, and zombie nautilus jockey spawning.

entities:elder_guardian.note: Mining fatigue and spikes work; the beam attack does not exist.

items.text: Teleports away from projectiles and towards targets
Fangs, vex summon and wololo spells

entities:giant.note: Vanilla giant registers no goals at all. Pumpkin adds a small goal set on top.

entities:guardian.note: Swims with the generic set and hurts attackers. The beam attack, the whole identity of the mob, does not exist.

entities:husk.note: Implements difficulty-scaled Hunger on unarmed melee hits, submerged conversion to zombie, camel husk jockey spawning, and inherited zombie goals.

entities:magma_cube.note: Built on the slime entity, so it inherits the full slime goal set.

items.text: Slime goal set: attack, jump, split

entities:parched.note: New in 26.2, wraps the skeleton base.

entities:phantom.note: Implements circling and swooping flight AI, cat avoidance, insomnia-based natural spawning, and size-scaled damage.

entities:piglin.note: Bartering, admiring and zombification all work on a hand-rolled activity system. The vanilla brain port replaces that system rather than adding features.

items.text: Bartering with gold and barter loot
Celebrating and dancing after a hunt
Crossbow and melee attack, repellent avoidance

entities:skeleton.note: Bow and melee goals are registered at the same time, so skeletons walk up and hit you with the bow.

items.text: Swap bow and melee on held-item change

entities:slime.note: Goal set matches vanilla. Landing particles are still pending.

items.text: Slime chunk and swamp spawn rules

entities:spider.note: Daylight-gated targeting and armadillo avoidance are implemented. LeapAtTargetGoal and wall-climbing navigation remain missing.

entities:stray.note: Wraps the skeleton base with powder snow spawn checks.

items.text: Sky and powder snow spawn rules
Melee attack, raid movement, revenge goal, and creaking avoidance

entities:vindicator.note: Raid movement, melee combat, revenge targeting, and creaking avoidance are implemented. Johnny-named all-mob targeting remains missing.

entities:warden.note: Placeholder goals only. Sniffing, the sonic boom and anger are all brain driven in vanilla.

entities:witch.note: Throws and drinks potions and joins raids, but never heals other raiders.

items.text: Drinks potions to heal and resist
Melee-only weapon handling, inherits the bow goal

entities:zombie.note: Implements zombie melee, spear usage, village movement, reinforcements, door breaking, baby +50% speed modifier, and 2.5x baby XP multiplier.

items.text: Zombie attack, sun burn, water conversion, and 2.5x baby XP reward

entities:zombie_villager.note: Implements villager profession/gossip/trade persistence, weakness + golden apple curing with iron bars/bed acceleration, and village movement.

items.text: Zombie goal set and nether spawn rules

entities:zombified_piglin.note: Implements anger targeting, group alerts, spear-use combat, and baby/jockey spawning.

entities:ender_dragon.note: All twelve flight phases are ported. Collision and damage still run against the main bounding box instead of the parts.

items.text: Part tracking, not yet registered as world entities

entities:wither.note: Shoots skulls from all three heads and breaks blocks, but does not fly and only targets whatever hurt it.

items.text: Spawning from soul sand and skulls
Wither skulls from all three heads

entities:bee.note: Registers the generic animal set only, so bees never enter hives, pollinate or grow crops.

items.text: Nectar, sting and hive timer state
`SitWhenOrderedToGoal`, sit pose is synced but not enforced

entities:fox.note: Stalking, crouching, pouncing, breeding/trust, and defending trusted players are implemented. Powder-snow climbing, shelter/sleeping, and berry foraging goals remain unimplemented.

items.text: Powder-snow climbing, shelter/sleeping, and berry foraging goals
Tongue attack on slimes and magma cubes

entities:happy_ghast.note: Tempts, leashes and holds still, approximated with goals.

items.text: Player targeting from anger and reputation

entities:nautilus.note: New in 26.2. Taming, riding and dash state exist, but no goals are registered.

entities:panda.note: Genes and pose flags are synced, but every panda-specific goal is missing.

items.text: Sit, lie on back, sneeze and roll
Saddle and carrot on a stick

entities:turtle.note: Implements home-beach egg laying, amphibious navigation and move control, seagrass breeding, and lightning bowl drops.

items.text: Beach spawn rules and egg state flags
Prey targets for sheep, rabbit, fox and skeleton
`SitWhenOrderedToGoal`, sit pose is synced but not enforced
Remaining prey: baby turtle, stray, bogged, parched, bat
Gossip and reputation with trade discounts
Loyalty and riptide through the item

items.text: Placement, sitting and spawn colour metadata

blocks:beacon.note: Pyramid level validation, periodic effect application, and GUI handling exist in BeaconBlockEntity, but BeaconBlock omits placed/broken block entity lifecycle hooks and beam occlusion checks.

items.text: Pyramid base validation, periodic effect application, and GUI screen
Block placement/removal block entity wiring and sky beam occlusion checks

blocks:beehive.note: Stores bees, but bees never enter or leave it.

blocks:creaking_heart.note: Updates Uprooted and Dormant states from flanking Pale Oak logs, but CreakingHeartBlockEntity has no tick to transition to Awake, spawn or link a Creaking, or generate resin.

items.text: Flanking Pale Oak log validation and Uprooted/Dormant state updates
Day/night Awake ticking, Creaking spawning/linking, and resin generation

blocks:dirt_path.note: Obstructed scheduled conversion to dirt and the fence-gate exception are implemented. Entity upward displacement on dirt conversion remains a TODO.

items.text: Scheduled dirt conversion and fence-gate support check
Push entities up when converting to dirt

blocks:farmland.note: Water fluid hydration, rain hydration, crop check, fence-gate exception, and trampling are implemented. Entity upward displacement on dirt conversion remains a TODO.

items.text: Water/rain hydration, crop detection, fence-gate check, and trampling
Push entities up when converting to dirt

blocks:infested.note: Silk Touch and block_drops game rule checks are implemented. Breaking still constructs a generic Entity with the silverfish type rather than SilverfishEntity.

items.text: Silk Touch and `block_drops` game rule checks

blocks:jukebox.note: Disc playback, state updates, and comparator notifications on replacement are implemented. Insertion still omits the BlockChange game event.

items.text: Disc insertion/ejection, comparator output, and replacement comparator update

blocks:lodestone.note: Compass binding via LodestoneTrackerImpl is implemented in CompassItem::use_on_block.

blocks:structure_block.note: Stores settings. Loading and saving structures is not verified.

blocks:vault.note: Key validation and state transitions exist, but use_with_item drops hardcoded emerald, diamond, and iron stacks instead of rolling configured loot tables, VaultBlockEntity has no tick state machine, and rewarded_players is not persisted to NBT.

items.text: Key validation, state changes, and sounds
Vault loot table rolls, tick cycle, and rewarded-player NBT persistence

blocks:sculk-sculk_catalyst.note: Placement state and scheduled-tick bloom reset are implemented. Death listener and sculk-spreading block entity remain unimplemented.

items.text: Placement state and scheduled bloom reset
Death listener and sculk spread block entity

blocks:sculk-sculk_shrieker.note: Direct player stepping, warning levels, Darkness application, and Warden spawning are implemented, but world game events do not dispatch vibrations to shriekers.

items.text: Step activation, warning levels, Darkness effect, and Warden summoning

blocks:piston-piston.note: Extension, sticky retraction, rapid retraction pulse dropping, entity pushing, and activate/deactivate game events are implemented. Moving-piston NBT still omits pushed_block_state.

items.text: Push/pull solver, rapid retraction, entity pushing, and game events

blocks:redstone-dispenser.note: Projectiles, experience bottles, buckets, fire charges, flint and steel, shears, saddles, TNT, shulker boxes, and armor dispensing are implemented. Bone meal, boats, and brush dispensing remain incomplete.

items.text: Projectiles, experience bottles, buckets, ignition, shears, saddles, TNT, armor, and shulker boxes
Bone meal, boat, chest-on-equine, and brush dispensing

blocks:redstone-sculk_sensor.note: Redstone signal output, calibrated directional filtering, and phase cooldown ticks are implemented, but World::post_game_event only notifies mob listeners and never triggers sculk sensors.

items.text: Active/cooldown phase transitions, comparator output, and calibrated input filtering
World game-event vibration listener dispatch to SculkSensorBlock::trigger

blocks:redstone-tripwire.note: Entity detection, hook updates, spectator filtering, and Shear game event emission are implemented. Shears durability deduction and trap-avoiding entity filtering remain TODOs.

items.text: Entity detection, hook updates, spectator check, and `GameEvent::Shear`
Shears item durability and `canAvoidTraps` entity filter

items:arrow.note: Registration. Flight and damage live in the arrow entity.

items:mace.note: Implements piecewise smash damage scaling, Density and Breach enchantment hooks, AoE knockback, fall-reset impulse context, and landing particles.

items:shield.note: Registration. Blocking lives in the combat code.

items:swords.note: Registration. Sweep and damage live in the combat code.

items:chorus_fruit.note: Random teleport handled in the living entity path.

items:compass.note: Lodestone binding on right-click is implemented, but inventory ticking does not clear the target when the linked lodestone is broken.

Inventory tick verification of tracked lodestone block
